summary: Confirmed 50 A, water, reservable; $8 low is the off-season walk-in non-electric rate (peak $18-26); count 146 -> 145; added pull-throughs, weekend/holiday minimums, 14-in-30 limit, some FCFS. Lakefront confirmed on imagery.
flags: FEES: the stored $8 low is real but off-season: it is the 'First-come, First-served Season' walk-in rate for a non-electric site (Sep 16-May 14). Non-electric sites take RVs and run 35-69 ft, so $8 stands as the base; peak May 15-Sep 15 is $18 non-electric, $24 electric, $26 water and electric (2026 and 2027 tables). A $52 'u40' electric template appears in the rate table but no catalogued site uses it.

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront) confirmed on imagery with the catalog's per-site coordinates: the outer rows of the D and F loops on the peninsula's east shore (D05-D17, F07-F11) and the C loop's west-shore sites sit on pads outside the loop road with open mown grass running 20-40 m to the shoreline, and the north tip's E/F sites are likewise open to the water. No road or day use between those pads and the lake.

Count: the catalog holds 145 individual sites (117 electric, 28 non-electric) plus 2 group units; the rec.gov description says '159 reservable modern campsites'. Recorded 145. The Walk-In-only fee season and 22 catalog sites flagged not reservable online make this fcfs some_sites.

Phone 785-658-2551 not confirmed: recreation.gov's record carries no phone and the USACE Kansas City District pages refuse plain HTTP. Pin fine (~30 m from the all-site centroid 38.94087,-98.57170). Season not stated by rec.gov (rate seasons are not a campground season); left unset. militaryDiscount rule present but not a discount claim; not written.
